extracted.intended_audience: students and general readers of Indian/Vedic history and comparative religion
extracted.subtask_description: A textbook-style chapter summarizing social and religious developments of the Vedic Age, covering Aryan society, caste origins, priestly cults, Vedic literature (Samaveda, Yajurveda, Atharva-veda, Upanishads), and sacrificial myths and rituals (Purusha, horse and human sacrifices).
